observations.finding: For T=S_a union S_b, keep selects only directed T-to-(V minus T) incidences. Unique reciprocal original edges imply each compact interior star has distinct terminal neighbours. With C=A_TU D_U^-1 A_UT, c_i=sum_u k_u/d_u and diagonal kappa_i=sum_u 1/d_u. Source degree=sum_u(k_u-1)/d_u, and action sum_u[k_u Q_i-sum_j Q_j]/d_u equals diag(c)Q-CQ=diag(c-kappa)Q-offdiag(C)Q. Thus self affinity cancels exactly in real arithmetic and every k=1 star supplies zero coupling.

full_degree is counted from all nonloop public_row entries before selecting T/U. It includes every interior-interior and terminal-interior neighbour. Other S classes and W/R/A/public nodes are allowed interiors without inspecting their labels. Only supplied copied S labels define membership and the fixed within-class permutation. Classifier edges/self-loops are untouched.

Each interior contributes (1/d_u) times its terminal clique Laplacian: x^T L_B x=sum_u (1/d_u) sum_{i<j in N_T(u)}(x_i-x_j)^2>=0. L_D and L_B are symmetric PSD and annihilate constants. s=1+d_D,max+d_B,max is positive; both live and bridge-permuted combined norm are <=2(d_D,max+d_B,max)/s<2, using permutation invariance of the bridge spectrum/degree multiset. Floating-point residuals are not qualified by this algebra.

Seed17 hash rule maps increasing IDs within each S class onto its hash ordering; pair p is its valid class-preserving restriction. q[inverse] followed by bridge result[p] yields (L_B control)ij=(L_B)_{p[i],p[j]}, matching the original native inverse-edge reindexing. Coverage degree values use partners[p] and DSU star endpoints use inverse, consistently. Both banks share identical raw-unit direct object, bridge factor and scalar normalization. Direct strength is invariant between these paired banks; compared with the old direct-only 1/(1+d_D,max), the new common rescaling can change its coefficient, as the selected operator defines.
